senses.gloss: m. (κινάρα, acc. pl.) artichokes (used as singular, collective noun).
units: Kil. V, 8 והק׳ כלאים בכרם (Mish. ed. ם …, corr. acc.; Ms. M. והקנדס, ed. Ven. קינדס, corr. acc.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) artichokes in a vineyard are kilayim; Tosef. ib. III, 12 הכינריס (Var. קִנָרָא, קינרס).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> (expl. <he>דרדר</he> or <he>קוץ</he>) <he>ק׳</he> (eds. vary between <he>קנדים</he>, <cite ref="S01052"><he>קינרים</he></cite> &c.); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 32:5">Yalk. ib. 32</cite> <he>קונדס</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 1:6">Ukts. I, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Uktsin 1:6">Tosef. ib. I, 6</cite> <cite ref="S01052"><he>קינרוס</he></cite> (Var. <cite ref="S02296"><he>קתרוס</he></cite>, corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:2">Esth. R. to I, 4</cite> they found themselves short of one plate <he>מאן דאמר קנדס ומאן דאמר כַּפְנָאֵי</he> one says, it was artichokes, another says, it was a dish of the efflorescence of palms (v. <cite ref="K01038"><he>כָּפְנִית</he></cite>, and <cite ref="S00559"><he>קוֹר</he> I</cite>).—Pl. <cite ref="S01052"><he>קִינָרִים</he></cite>. Y. Shebi. IX, 38ᵈ top (ed. Krot. <he>קינריס</he>). Gen. R. l. c. (v. supra).
